subject.title: fix(reef): keep accepted receipt audits serializable

question: Should this protected Reef fix merge on the focused regression assertion alone, or should it first include a redacted real restart/replay proof?
rationale: The code change is small and plausibly correct, but the provided PR body and visible discussion do not establish the claimed production recovery path; the protected label requires maintainer handling rather than automated disposition.

options.title: Request restart/replay proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript, runtime log, or recording showing an accepted receipt persists and inbox replay advances after a gateway restart.

options.title: Accept focused-test evidence
options.body: A maintainer may merge based on the narrow payload assertion if they already have trusted operational coverage for the restart/replay path.

recommendation.title: Request restart/replay proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript, runtime log, or recording showing an accepted receipt persists and inbox replay advances after a gateway restart.
